targets.formattedQuery: SELECT $timeSeries as t, count() FROM $table WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
targets.query:
SELECT
  t1.*,
  conv_symbol_to_token_v2(t1.ex, t1.s) token_1,
  t2.ccid
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ex, s, k
  FROM (
    SELECT ex, s, k
    FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ex, s, k
    FROM default.tickers
  )
  WHERE (k = 'fut' AND ex != 'binance') OR (k = 'spot' AND ex = 'bybit')
) t1
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT *
  FROM default.ex_k_to_ccid
  WHERE k = 'fut'
) t2
  ON t1.ex = t2.ex AND token_1 = t2.base
WHERE t2.ccid = ''
  AND startsWith(notes, 'not-on-ui-on-') = 0
  AND startsWith(notes, 'delisted-on-') = 0
  AND startsWith(notes, 'index-fut-custom-for-ex-') = 0
ORDER BY ex, s

SELECT * EXCEPT (rank_out, _fund_1h_min, _fund_1h_max)
FROM (
    SELECT
        ccid,
        truncate(_fund_1h_max - _fund_1h_min, 6) diff_abs_1h,
        truncate(_fund_1h_max * 8 - _fund_1h_min * 8, 6) diff_abs_8h,
        first_value(ex) OVER w_asc AS ex_min,
        first_value(ex) OVER w_desc AS ex_max,
        first_value(ts) OVER w_asc AS ts_min,
        first_value(ts) OVER w_desc AS ts_max,
        token_1,
        first_value(funding_rate_1h) OVER w_asc AS _fund_1h_min,
        first_value(funding_rate_1h) OVER w_desc AS _fund_1h_max,
        truncate(_fund_1h_min, 6) fund_1h_min,
        truncate(_fund_1h_max, 6) fund_1h_max,
        truncate(_fund_1h_min * 8, 6) fund_8h_min,
        truncate(_fund_1h_max * 8, 6) fund_8h_max,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY ccid) rank_out
    FROM (
        SELECT * EXCEPT (rank)
        FROM (
            SELECT
                t1.ex,
                conv_symbol_to_token_v2(t1.ex, s) token_1,
                t1.funding_rate / t1.funding_hours funding_rate_1h,
                row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY ex, s ORDER BY ts DESC) AS rank,
                t2.ccid,
                toDateTime(t1.ts / 1000) ts
            FROM (
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT s, funding_rate * 100 funding_rate, ts, ex, k, ts_write, toUInt64(t2.funding_interval / 60) funding_hours
                    FROM (
                        SELECT *
                        FROM default.tickers
                        WHERE ex = 'bybit' AND k = 'fut'
                    ) t1
                    INNER JOIN (
                        SELECT s, funding_interval
                        FROM default.bybit_instruments_info
                        WHERE k = 'fut'
                    ) t2
                        ON t1.s = t2.s
                )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT s, funding_rate * 100 funding_rate, ts * 1000 ts, ex, k, ts_write, funding_hours
                    FROM (
                        SELECT *
                        FROM default.tickers
                        WHERE ex = 'gateio' AND k = 'fut'
                    ) t1
                    INNER JOIN (
                        SELECT s, toUInt64(JSONExtract(contract_raw, 'funding_interval', 'UInt64') / 60 / 60) funding_hours
                        FROM default.gateio_contracts
                        WHERE k = 'fut'
                    ) t2
                        ON t1.s = t2.s
                )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT s, funding_rate * 100 funding_rate, ts, ex, k, ts_write, 1 funding_hours
                    FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
                    WHERE ex = 'hyperliquid'
                )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT s, funding_rate * 100 funding_rate, ts * 1000 ts, ex, k, ts_write, 1 funding_hours
                    FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
                    WHERE ex = 'arkm'
                )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT s, funding_rate * 100 funding_rate, ts, ex, k, ts_write, funding_interval funding_hours
                    FROM (
                        SELECT *
                        FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
                        WHERE ex = 'paradex'
                    ) t1
                    INNER JOIN (
                        SELECT s, funding_interval
                        FROM default.paradex_markets
                        WHERE k = 'fut'
                    ) t2
                        ON t1.s = t2.s
                )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT s, funding_rate / 10e17 funding_rate, ts * 1000 ts, ex, k, ts_write, 1 funding_hours
                    FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
                    WHERE ex = 'polynomial-fi'
                )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT s, funding_rate * 100 funding_rate, ts, ex, k, ts_write, 1 funding_hours
                    FROM default.tickers
                    WHERE ex = 'apex-pro'
                )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT s, funding_rate * 100 funding_rate, ts, ex, k, ts_write, 1 funding_hours
                    FROM default.tickers
                    WHERE ex = 'apex-omni'
                )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT s, funding_rate * 100 funding_rate, ts, ex, k, ts_write, 1 funding_hours
                    FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
                    WHERE ex = 'aevo'
                )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT s, funding_rate, ts, ex, k, ts_write, 8 funding_hours
                    FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
                    WHERE ex = 'bitunix'
                )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT s, funding_rate * 100 funding_rate, ts, ex, k, ts_write, 8 funding_hours
                    FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
                    WHERE ex = 'coinex'
                )
                UNION ALL
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT s, funding_rate * 100 funding_rate, ts * 1000 ts, ex, k, ts_write, 8 funding_hours
                    FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
                    WHERE ex = 'bingx'
                )
            ) t1
            INNER JOIN (
                SELECT *
                FROM default.ex_k_to_ccid
                WHERE k = 'fut'
            ) t2
                ON t1.ex = t2.ex AND token_1 = t2.base
            WHERE t2.ccid != ''
                AND startsWith(notes, 'not-on-ui-on-') = 0
                AND startsWith(notes, 'delisted-on-') = 0
                AND startsWith(notes, 'index-fut-custom-for-ex-') = 0
                AND ts_write >= NOW() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE
        )
        WHERE rank = 1
    )
    WINDOW w_asc AS (PARTITION BY ccid ORDER BY funding_rate_1h ASC),
        w_desc AS (PARTITION BY ccid ORDER BY funding_rate_1h DESC)
)
WHERE rank_out = 1
ORDER BY abs(diff_abs_1h) DESC
LIMIT 10

targets.formattedQuery: SELECT $timeSeries as t, count() FROM $table WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
targets.query:
SELECT
  toDateTime(t1.ts_write) ts_write,
  conv_symbol_to_token_v2(ex, s) token_1,
  t1.funding_rate
FROM (
  SELECT ex, k, ts_write, s, funding_rate
  FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ex, k, ts_write, s, funding_rate
  FROM default.tickers
) t1
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT *
  FROM default.ex_k_to_ccid
  WHERE k = 'fut'
) t2
  ON t1.ex = t2.ex AND token_1 = t2.base
WHERE t2.ccid != ''
  AND ts_write BETWEEN toDateTime($from) AND toDateTime($to)
  AND t1.k = 'fut'
  AND t1.ex = '$var_fundings_ex'
  AND t2.ccid = '$var_fundings_ccid'
ORDER BY ts_write

  FROM default.fundings_curr_2025_01_12
  UNION ALL

INNER JOIN (

  WHERE k = 'fut'
) t2
  ON t1.ex = t2.ex AND token_1 = t2.base
WHERE t2.ccid != ''
  AND ts_write BETWEEN toDateTime(1742643252) AND toDateTime(1742664852)

ORDER BY ts_write
